newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises special three-month T-bill rate.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises special three-month T-bill rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it had raised its special series three-month Treasury bill rate to 10.20 percent from 10.10 percent.
The rate hike came two days after the auction rate moved up by 6.3 basis points to 10.356 percent.
The special series T-bill rate serves as the benchmark for secondary trading in 91-day Treasury bills.
The Central Bank did not change its overnight and term reverse repo rates.
